help.text: Open SmartView with the instance link (globe icon). Pages and tiles are set up in the app itself (✎ at the top right). For push notifications on the iPhone install the certificate once: page /zertifikat.

https.label: HTTPS with own certificate (needed for push notifications)

certCollection.label: Certificate collection of the acme adapter (optional)
certCollection.help: Empty = own SmartView certificate (install once per device). With a Let's Encrypt certificate from the acme adapter (e.g. collection 'default') nothing has to be installed on the devices; then enter the domain as address below.

publicHost.label: Address of the ioBroker server (optional)
publicHost.help: Empty = detected automatically. Also used for the certificate.

accessKey.label: Access key (optional)
accessKey.help: If set, SmartView must be opened once with ?key=... per device

allowEdit.label: Allow editing in the app
allowEdit.help: Switch off when the layout is finished, so nobody changes it by accident

usersOff.label: Switch users off (emergency, e.g. forgotten password)
usersOff.help: Users are set up in the app (menu → Benutzer). Tick this only to get in again without a password, then set a new one and untick it.

remoteModeInfo.text: Open SmartView from anywhere without VPN app and without an open port on the router. Only SmartView is reachable, never the ioBroker admin. From outside a user login with the authenticator code is always required - set up users and two-factor at home first (menu).

options.label: Own server (relay program of the VMS, e.g. IONOS)

funnelHttps.label: Funnel port
funnelHttps.help: 443 = address without port. 8443 / 10000 if the VMS already uses 443 on this computer

funnelHelp.text: Tailscale must be installed and logged in on the ioBroker computer (tailscale.com/download/linux, then 'sudo tailscale up' and once 'sudo tailscale set --operator=iobroker'). Status, address and the approval link: in SmartView menu → Fernzugang. Sound of the intercom does not work from outside (TCP only).

relayServer.label: Own server (address)
relayServer.help: Public IP or name of the server running alvms-relay

relayDomain.label: Name for outside (DuckDNS)
relayDomain.help: e.g. my-smartview.duckdns.org - a second DuckDNS name pointing to the server IP

relayCertCollection.label: Certificate collection for this name (acme)
relayCertCollection.help: Empty = the collection of HTTPS above. The certificate must contain the name for outside.

relayHelp.text: The key and the line for the server (alvms-relay add …) are shown in SmartView menu → Fernzugang. The server only passes the encrypted connection on; the certificate stays here. Program and guide: tools/remote.

vpsHeader.text: Or: own VPS with WireGuard + reverse proxy

remoteInfo.text: Only for an own VPS that forwards SmartView through WireGuard (guide: tools/remote/ANLEITUNG.md). Otherwise leave empty.

proxyIps.label: Address(es) of the reverse proxy
proxyIps.help: e.g. 10.77.0.1 (WireGuard address of the VPS). Requests from there count as 'from outside': a user login is always required (set up users first). Empty = off.

options.label: everything as at home (PIN still asked)

external2fa.label: From outside also the authenticator code (two-factor)
external2fa.help: Recommended. Each user sets it up once at home: menu → Zwei-Faktor (Microsoft/Google Authenticator).

externalUrl.label: Address from outside (for links in messages)
externalUrl.help: Empty = the address of the way above. e.g. https://smartview.example.com - Telegram/WhatsApp/push links then work everywhere
